title: Headless TTW Holy Water (DLC03WQ03): from Bigsley's request about Megaton through Brother Gerard's holy water and the Apostles of the Holy Light's monastery to Bigsley's reward (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Broken Steel's water quests open once the player wakes after Take it Back! (the MQ11 chain's end). So that the add-on's world is set up as in play, the chain wakes the player in the Citadel first (DLC03BS1 0, as the ending's script does [observed]). Then Bigsley at Project Purity asks about Megaton's water (his 'yes' line [observed] sets DLC03WQ 2, which sets Holy Water (DLC03WQ03) 10).
Travel stand-in: to Bigsley at Project Purity.

actions.label: D1: two jobs (adds the Megaton topic)

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to Megaton. Rosa's way in (stage 50) waits on the water beggar's scene (her greeting needs DLC03WQ03 variable 2 set); this chain takes the other way: Brother Gerard of the Apostles of the Holy Light, preaching in Megaton, gives the player his holy water (stage 55).

actions.label: milestone: DLC03WQ03 55, drink the holy water

actions.text: The player drinks it: its effect script [observed] sets stage 56.

The monastery's door (0x0D003A22, locked at level 100) wants DLC03WQ03MonasteryKey (BrokenSteel.esm, 0x0D0071E6 here), which only Gerard's lines INFO 0x0D0071D4, 0x0D0071D6 and 0x0D0071D8 give ('player.additem 0x0D0071E6 1', in BrokenSteel.esm and TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm) [observed: decompiled]; the 1A/2A answers above say 0x0D007E1B and 0x0D007E1E, which set stage 60 and give no key [observed: pilot rerun log]. Which topic holds those lines is not checked. Stand-in: the player is given the key.
Travel stand-in: to the Apostles' monastery; walking into its trigger [observed] (DLC03WQ03MonasteryScript) sets stage 100 (Gerard alive).

actions.label: how do you make your holy water (adds the next topic)

actions.text: Travel stand-in: back to Bigsley at Project Purity, who pays (stage 200).
